_about: Public-domain Hanmer William Webb-Peploe (1837-1923), vicar of St. Paul's, Onslow Square, and a leading Keswick speaker, for the Word Hoard: The Life of Privilege (1896), The Victorious Life, his Northfield addresses (1896), and The Titles of Jehovah (1901). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 71 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

peploe-life-of-privilege: The life of privilege : possession, peace, and power (New York : Fleming H. Revell, 1896)
peploe-victorious-life: The victorious life : the post-conference addresses delivered at East Northfield, Mass., August 17-25, 1895 (New York : The Baker & Taylor Co., 1896)
peploe-titles-of-jehovah: The titles of Jehovah: A course of sermons (James Nisbet & Co., Limited, 1901)
